name: celestial-zodiac-map
title: Celestial Zodiac Map
description: Antique star constellation chart with coordinate meridian lines and celestial astrological markers.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Full Bleed
Density: Airy
Shape: Pill
Motion: None
Typography: Serif Display
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Passive Astronomy Chart: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
